unlisted_practices: Two-stage semantic parsing of narrative trial eligibility criteria into structured patterns, then LLM-agent SQL generation for EHR cohort identification
Expert review of generated queries for clinical match accuracy on a real-world EHR cohort

screen.reason: Evaluates a proposed two-stage LLM agent framework (EC2Seq2Sql) for converting clinical trial eligibility criteria into SQL queries on real-world EHR data, but evaluates model/pipeline accuracy rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
